role: XCTest suite for the archive's RR splice on re-archive: ArchiveStore.storedRRSeries three-way classification (preserved / noBeatsStored / unreadable) and that a metadata-only re-archive keeps stored beats while a beatless workout stays beatless.
types: ArchiveRRPreservationTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase over SessionArchive RR preservation
state: mem:ArchiveRRPreservationTests.archive (lazy SessionArchive with no directory: → production default archive directory)
toplevel: lazy archive = SessionArchive(sleepScheduleProvider: 22:00/8h, sessionMergeModeProvider: .defaultGap) with no directory and no mergeGapProvider, so it opens the shared production archive directory and reads the merge gap from AppDependencies settings.

flags.text: The archive is built without `directory:`, so every test writes into the shared App Group archive the app host uses (the init comment says default instances all point at the same on-disk directory). tearDown's delete only moves files to trash and records tombstones, so each run leaves trash/tombstone residue in the real archive, and residue from other suites can affect merges here.

units.does: Async tearDown: on the main actor, try? deletes every written session id (errors swallowed), clears the list, then calls super.
units.entry: XCTest: instance tearDown() async after each test
writes: file:SessionArchive default App Group archive directory (production location; index.json, deleted.json, Trash/)

units.does: Builds an RRSeries of count (default 50) synthetic beats 780-820 ms starting at 1,800,000,000 s.

units.does: Builds a complete 10-minute walk workout HRVSession with no RR data at a fixed 2027 start and records its id for cleanup.
Archives a beatless workout and asserts storedRRSeries classifies it as .noBeatsStored.

flags.text: This suite's SessionArchive and the app host's collector archive (built at launch and read in EmuquApp) both own index.json in the same default directory, each with its own in-memory index loaded once at init; every save rewrites the whole file from that instance's index, so the test instance's saves drop entries the host saved after the test loaded, and the host's next save drops the test entries (leaving their files as orphans for reconcileOrphanFiles to adopt).
